comment: The wording table for the masthead age, the next-update line, and the stale threshold. internal/web/templates/freshness_test.go pins the Go code against it in CI. app.js (relativeAgeLabel, relativeDueLabel, refreshRelativeTimes) implements the same rules, but CI has no JavaScript runtime: the browser check that reads this file (Playwright with a mocked clock) is a manual, local verification. Change a rule in Go and update this file, then rerun that check.
